# WP01 — Intake Template

## Objectives & Success Criteria
- A one-page intake template so every incoming report arrives with reproducible detail.
- Success: three consecutive intakes complete the template without follow-up questions.

## Context & Constraints
- The template lives beside the mission; no tooling required to fill it.

## Subtask Guidance
T001 — Open the intake template with the standard sections.
T002 — Define the tag vocabulary for routing intake records.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Template reviewed by the mission owner
